sentences.text: Actinomyces graevenitzii is described as a relatively uncommon Actinomyces species, an oral species predominantly recovered from respiratory locations.
The same report describes it as a Gram-positive anaerobic or microaerobic filamentous bacterium that can induce pyogenic and granulomatous inflammation.

A case report describes pulmonary actinomycosis as a chronic respiratory infection caused by Actinomyces, and reports endobronchial actinomycosis after foreign-body aspiration in which this species was identified.
That report also describes it as a rare species of Actinomyces with rare cases of infection.

In microfluidic co-culture, Streptococcus and Staphylococcus were reported to be excluded from the medium immediately surrounding Actinomyces graevenitzii microcolonies, a structure not seen with several other species tested.
